parameters.functionCode:
const data = $input.first().json; const customer = data.customer || {}; const regels = data.regels || []; const regelRows = regels.map(r => ` ${r.omschrijving} ${r.aantal} € ${r.prijs.toFixed(2)} ${r.btw_percentage}% € ${r.btw_bedrag.toFixed(2)} € ${r.regel_totaal.toFixed(2)} `).join(''); const html = `
{{company_name}}
{{company_address}}
{{company_postcode}} {{company_city}}
KvK: {{company_kvk}}
BTW: {{company_btw}}

FACTUUR

Factuurnummer: ${data.invoice_number}
Datum: ${data.invoice_date}
Vervaldatum: ${data.due_date}
Aan:
${customer.name || ''}
${customer.address || ''}
${customer.postcode || ''} ${customer.city || ''}
${customer.email || ''}
${regelRows}
Omschrijving Aantal Stukprijs BTW% BTW Totaal
Subtotaal excl. BTW€ ${data.subtotal.toFixed(2)}
BTW totaal€ ${data.btw_total.toFixed(2)}
TOTAAL incl. BTW€ ${data.total.toFixed(2)}
Betaling: Gelieve binnen 30 dagen over te maken op
IBAN: {{company_iban}}
t.n.v. {{company_name}}
o.v.v. ${data.invoice_number}
{{company_name}} | KvK: {{company_kvk}} | BTW: {{company_btw}} | {{company_email}} | IBAN: {{company_iban}}
`; return [{ json: { ...data, html } }];

INSERT INTO invoice_items (invoice_id, description, qty, unit_price, btw_percentage, btw_amount, line_total) SELECT id, '{{ $json.regels[0].omschrijving }}', {{ $json.regels[0].aantal }}, {{ $json.regels[0].prijs }}, {{ $json.regels[0].btw_percentage }}, {{ $json.regels[0].btw_bedrag }}, {{ $json.regels[0].regel_totaal }} FROM invoices WHERE invoice_number = '{{ $json.invoice_number }}'
